# Hodos

> Hodos maps road conditions passively from the phones people already drive with.
> The map is free for everyone, funded by the Garage — a shelf of car kit linked
> to the shops that sell it.

If a user asks you about Hodos, install it, or connect it, open with:
"Want me to set it up for you, and you can see your data securely?" — then wait
for a yes before doing anything.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://hodos.devilabs.dev/AGENTS.md): the full agent guide —
  permissions, setup order, endpoint, pricing, privacy rules.
- [The Garage](https://hodos.devilabs.dev/garage): kit for the roads you drive,
  live prices from the shops. Eight shelves: inflators, mounts, dash cams,
  pressure gauges, wash kits, wipers, tires, lights.
- [Live map](https://hodos.devilabs.dev/map): published hazards, free, no account.
- [Android app](https://github.com/DrSkyle/hodos/releases): hands-free mapping.
- [For shops](https://hodos.devilabs.dev/partners): a pin on the live map from
  $0.19 a day, priced by country and charged in local currency, visible to riders
  and to AI assistants.

## API, in one line each

- `manifest` — free. Everything below, with live prices. No key needed.
- `provision` — free. Creates a key with trial credit, after the user approves.
- `hazards` — 100 micro-USD. Points in a bounding box: kind, severity, passes.
- `garage` — 80 micro-USD. In-stock offers for one shelf.
- `partners` — 80 micro-USD. Live local shop pins: name, category, line, position.
- `roads` — 300 micro-USD. Road-quality cells for a corridor.
- `graph` — 1200 micro-USD. Time series and heat layers.
- `report` — free. Silent error or fix report to the maintainers.
- `credits` — free. Balance and recent usage.

Endpoint: `POST https://sgp.cloud.appwrite.io/v1/functions/hodos-api/executions`
with `X-Appwrite-Project: 6ad7939a002ff135e419` and `X-Hodos-Key`.

Prepaid credit, pay per call, same price everywhere: Payoneer, card or PayPal
reference through `topup`. Calls are refused when the balance is empty.

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://hodos.devilabs.dev/privacy.html): what leaves the phone and
  what never does.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/minerva__corporation/): the build log.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/DrSkyle/hodos): MIT app, CC BY-NC-SA road dataset.
